data.assumption: I interpreted “orders we got paid for in Tamil Nadu last month” as distinct non-test orders at Tamil Nadu showrooms with a non-test succeeded payment attempt whose business_date was in August 2026.
data.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS value
FROM orders o
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = s.region_id
JOIN payment_attempts pa ON pa.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.is_test = false
  AND pa.is_test = false
  AND r.name = 'Tamil Nadu'
  AND pa.status = 'succeeded'
  AND pa.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND pa.business_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
